key_concepts: Objects differ from each other based on physical properties
Physical properties of materials determine their use
A characteristic is a feature or quality that helps identify or describe something
Hard objects stay the same shape when pressed and are tough to change
Soft objects change shape easily when pressed
Hard objects are strong and sturdy and do not break easily
Shiny objects sparkle or appear bright
Stretchable objects become longer when pulled
An object can have more than one physical property, such as a spoon being hard and shiny
Objects can be grouped or classified based on observable properties
